title: Plan, apply and fresh verify are different authorities
summary: A plan explains the deterministic delta and ordered actions. Only apply mutates. After apply, Deployment must freshly discover and verify the target against the manifest; successful commands are evidence of actions, not proof that desired state exists.
invariants: Every action states reason, inputs, outputs, provider, destructive flag and reversibility.
The caller can inspect/serialise the plan before execution.
Post-deployment observed state satisfying the manifest is the success invariant.
Dry-run performs discover/assess/plan but no apply.

provenance.claim: Requires fresh post-apply verification and rejects rc=0 as sufficient evidence.
